# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > An interactive personality assessment tool from Britannica that explores different curiosity types and learning styles through engaging quizzes.

The Curiosity Compass helps users discover their unique curiosity personality—whether Explorer, Discoverer, or other types—drawing on neuroscience and the science of curiosity. Featured personalities include Marie Curie, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Malala Yousafzai, Amelia Earhart, Anthony Bourdain, and Ibn Baṭṭūṭah as examples of different curiosity archetypes.
